title: SessionInfo
description: Public session shape returned by list_sessions and get_session_info (with type "live") and emitted in session_started / session_closed events.

msg_count.description: Messages stored for the session before it started plus those sent or received since.

last_activity.description: RFC3339 timestamp. Omitted while it is unset.

remote_version.description: The peer's kamune version. Omitted when empty.

remote_addr.description: Where a dialed session was dialed: the server's address, the relay's for relay, "p2p" for p2p and the peer's for direct-p2p. Omitted for incoming sessions.
